title: ADR 0020: Jira-driven ticket execution protocol (targeted prompts and skills, zero cost)
problem: PO decision 2026-10-09: no harness (too heavy); execution uses targeted prompts and skills with Jira as the work queue. No written protocol exists, so every session would re-derive it and spend tokens.
value: One short protocol lets any session execute one ticket with minimal context and consistent git/Jira behaviour.
scope: Write audit/adr/0020-ticket-execution-protocol.md: select ticket by JQL (po-approved, ready, no open blocker), read the body from the repo backlog JSON (Jira markdown mangles some characters), create branch texo/PLRNUI-<n>-<slug> from texo/v1, implement only owned files, validate, post an evidence comment, open a PR to texo/v1
Token-economy rules: read only owned files and the ADR ids named in the ticket; no repo-wide exploration; stop after 3 failed attempts and report
Roles: author session and a separate reviewer session (E18-08); commit convention add|fix|chore(PLRNUI-<n>): msg
Forbidden for sessions: applying po-approved, publishing to npm, tags/Releases, pushing or merging main, skipping tests
outOfScope: Renaming package, repo or imports (Texo cutover is E15)
acceptance: audit/adr/0020-ticket-execution-protocol.md exists with Status Accepted and headings Decision, Selection, Branching, Token economy, Roles, Forbidden actions (grep)
The ADR contains the exact JQL for the ready queue (grep 'po-approved')
The ADR states that main is never pushed or merged by a session (grep)
risks: Protocol drift between sessions; keep it to one page and link it from every starter prompt
dod: All acceptance criteria verified by the listed commands
npm run typecheck and npm test green
No package/repo/import rename (00-brief)
